question: Is there real data linking Valorant agents played to mouse sensitivity (eDPI / cm/360)?
notes: 28 non-creator players from pro_data_audit.json (SirMaza, Shanks, PROD, Lothar excluded as creator_or_streamer).
VLR timespan=all is the longest window (all VLR-tracked matches, incl. tier-2/older seasons, back to ~2020); it does NOT match the time the current sens was used. timespan=90d also recorded.
DPI/sens taken as-is from pro_data_audit.json (ProSettings values); settings history over the all-time window is unknown.

external_datasets.name: BattlePooja - Average eDPI of Valorant Pro Players 2026
external_datasets.n: 9 'verified' pros total; per-role n not stated
external_datasets.method: Settings 'gathered from publicly available information including pro player streams, interviews, and community records'; role assignment method not stated

numbers.sentinel: card says no verified data; body text says 248

external_datasets.reliability: very low - n<=9, self-contradictory (Sentinel 248 with 0 sentinels), mislabels MaKo (a controller) as initiator; averages are of a handful of named players

external_datasets.name: edpicalculator.net - How to Calculate eDPI in Valorant
external_datasets.method: 'cross-referenced data from ProSettings, RaidGG, GamerHardware and BattlePooja'; role assignment not described
external_datasets.reliability: very low - appears to copy BattlePooja; stated averages not reproducible from its own table (duelist recomputes to 278, initiator is 1 player at 352), sentinel figure has no players

external_datasets.name: proconfig.net - eDPI distribution across 121 pros
external_datasets.method: histogram of 'verified pros', 50-eDPI bins; source unspecified
external_datasets.reliability: no agent/role data; role statements ('Sentinel / Operator main: 180-280', '100-149 almost exclusively Operator mains') are qualitative assertions with no counts

external_datasets.name: esportsettings.com - Valorant pro sensitivity guide
external_datasets.n: 435 pros overall; per-role n not given

numbers.recommendations: duelists 'often 180 to 300', sentinels '200 to 350' eDPI; sentinel/controller try 55-75 cm/360, duelist 40-60 cm/360

external_datasets.reliability: no measured role data; recommendations only; its own examples contradict its text

external_datasets.name: sensconverter.app - Valorant pro settings
external_datasets.method: streams/VODs/interviews/community DBs; has role filter buttons but role assignment not explained
external_datasets.reliability: low - ranges are hand-picked from examples, opposite direction to BattlePooja (duelists lower here); no medians/n

external_datasets.name: ProSettings.net VALORANT options guide
external_datasets.reliability: best overall source, but no per-agent/role breakdown; list page has no agent/role column

external_datasets.name: valorantscout.com - pro sensitivity database
external_datasets.method: ProSettings list snapshot (pros, creators, free agents, retired)

external_datasets.name: VLR.gg thread 'Rank and Sensitivity Survey'
external_datasets.method: informal forum replies; agent/role not asked

external_datasets.name: VLR.gg thread 'The Holy Grail of VALORANT Sens'
external_datasets.method: mean of 20 pros' eDPI from prosettings.net

external_datasets.name: tracker.gg / blitz.gg / mobalytics
external_datasets.method: searched; these sites publish agent pick/win rates and per-pro settings lists but nothing joining sensitivity to agent was found

external_datasets.name: specs.gg / settings.gg
external_datasets.method: no main-agent or role filter found

external_datasets.name: Reddit r/VALORANT surveys by role/main
external_datasets.method: web searches returned no survey broken down by role/main agent

external_datasets.name: Academic / peer-reviewed
external_datasets.method: web search found no paper relating FPS mouse sensitivity to Valorant agent/role
external_datasets.reliability: not found (Google Scholar/ACM not searched directly)

method.agent_shares: round share per agent = agent rounds / total rounds in VLR table (Rnd column); primary analysis on timespan=all (n=28), sensitivity re-run on timespan=90d (n=25; Lakia, ZynX, Veqaj have no 90d data)
method.reyna: excluded (not a movement-ability duelist); max Reyna all-time round share in the sample is small, so including it would not change group membership
method.primary_role: role with largest summed round share
method.test: two-sided permutation test on difference in mean ln(cm/360) between groups; exact enumeration when C(n,k)<=300000 else 200000 random permutations (seed 1)

caveats: n is tiny (28; subgroups 3-10) - power to detect anything but a large effect is very low
about 10 tests were run; with Bonferroni the threshold would be ~0.005, so no result is significant
all-time agent pools span 2020-2026 while sens is a single current snapshot; players' agent pools shifted a lot (e.g. Alfajer killjoy all-time vs neon 90d, crashies sova all-time vs viper/cypher 90d)
cm/360 values are discrete (9 of 28 players at 81.6 = 800x0.2 or 1600x0.1), producing ties
agent choice is driven by team needs, not sens; this is observational
